info.name: EvolutionaryScale Forge ESM3 Embeddings Sampling API

items.docs: Executes a single forward pass of ESM3 against a tokenized protein and samples tokens according to a `SamplingConfig`. Intended for power users who need fine-grained control over each iteration (for example, chain-of-thought protein design or custom sampling schedules).

Returns raw per-position logits, embeddings, and optional hidden states for a tokenized protein. The SDK discourages routine use because logits payloads are large; prefer encode + forward_and_sample for typical workflows.

info.name: Get ESM C Logits And Embeddings

items.docs: Returns per-residue sequence logits and (optionally) embeddings or hidden states for an `ESMProteinTensor` produced by `esmc/encode`. Use for representation learning, classification heads, mutational effect prediction, and similar downstream tasks.
